text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There is a crack in my 
naginata............ 
I see. Its time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...The day I first swung you in practice. 
It feels like it was only yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have served me well all this time. 
............Rest easy now, my friend.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, when Phalaenopsis arrived at 
the trainer's office, sorrow clouded her 
eyes. 
...She told me she had lost an "old 
comrade."
